verses.he: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.en: A Song of Ascents; of David. 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us', Let Israel now say;

verses.he: לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ בְּקוּם עָלֵינוּ אָדָם׃
verses.en: 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us, When men rose up against us,

verses.he: אֲזַי חַיִּים בְּלָעוּנוּ בַּחֲרוֹת אַפָּם בָּנוּ׃
verses.en: Then they had swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

verses.he: אֲזַי הַמַּיִם שְׁטָפוּנוּ נַחְלָה עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ׃
verses.en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul;
Then the proud waters Had gone over our soul.'

verses.he: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה שֶׁלֹּא נְתָנָנוּ טֶרֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶם׃
verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.he: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֹר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֹקְשִׁים הַפַּח נִשְׁבָּר וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִמְלָטְנוּ׃
verses.en: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers; The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.he: עֶזְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
verses.en: Our help is in the name of the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
